name: Art
description: Create and edit images or generate short videos with Cindy's media capabilities. You can also invoke it directly with $cindy-art.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to create images, illustrations, avatars, posters, or other artwork; edit a generated image by adding elements or changing its style; generate a short video; or animate a still image.

gen_image.description: Prepare ordinary parameters for text-to-image creation. Unless the user explicitly names a model in this conversation, the current Agent calls Cindy Core media with the image-generation model configured on the plugin details page.

edit_image.description: Prepare ordinary parameters to edit, redraw, stylize, or combine up to four source images. Unless the user explicitly names a model in this conversation, the current Agent calls Cindy Core media with the image-editing model configured on the plugin details page.

gen_video.description: Prepare ordinary parameters for text-to-video creation. Unless the user explicitly names a model in this conversation, the current Agent calls Cindy Core media with the video-generation model configured on the plugin details page.

edit_video.description: Prepare ordinary parameters for image-to-video creation: one reference image is the first frame and two represent the first and last frames. Unless the user explicitly names a model in this conversation, the current Agent calls Cindy Core media with the image-to-video model configured on the plugin details page.
